title: Work tape cells away from the head
statement: Let $k'$ be a natural number, let $\mathrm{Symbol}$ and $\mathrm{State}$ be types, and fix an input word. For an action $a$ on $k'$ work tapes and a configuration $c$ for that input, the content at position $z \in \mathbb{Z}$ on tape $i$ is unchanged by applying $a$ to $c$ whenever $i$ is a tape index and $z$ differs from the position of the $i$-th work-tape head in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k'$ of work tapes
A symbol type and a state type
A configuration for that input and $k'$ tapes
An integer position $z$ different from the head position of tape $i$
replaced:
Let $a$ be a one-step action of a machine with $k'$ work tapes, let $c$ be a
configuration of such a machine, let $i$ be a work-tape index, and let $z$ be
an integer cell position different from the position of the $i$-th work head
in $c$.  Then after applying $a$ to $c$, the content of cell $z$ of the $i$-th
work tape is unchanged.
